description: Enrol the authenticated customer in the restaurant loyalty programme. Returns the member id, current points balance, and tier. Safe to call even if the customer is already enrolled — returns existing data in that case. Requires an active agent_session_id and the customer email or phone.

display_name.description: Optional display name shown in the loyalty dashboard.

email.description: Customer email (either email or phone required).

phone.description: Customer phone in E.164 format (either email or phone required).

name: join_loyalty
title: Join the loyalty programme
